_provenance: S2.MONEY-QUANTITY.XB (2026-07-20, wave-2 finding-3 repoint). Values below are what the REAL payment HTTP wire emits — backend/src/main/java/com/ax/template/authblueprint/payment/PaymentBodyMapper.toBody(Payment) (the Map<String,Object> body PaymentController actually returns; formerly the private paymentBody), derived from Payment.java (BigDecimal amount, precision=19 scale=8) + PaymentService.scale()/CURRENCY_SCALES (KRW=0, USD=2) + PaymentBodyMapper.canonicalize() (strips trailing zeros). refundUsd is the LIVE RefundResponse body PaymentController#refund returns. Locked byte-equal by backend/src/test/java/com/ax/template/authblueprint/payment/MoneyContractParityTest.java (BE leg) and frontend/tests/money-contract-parity.vitest.ts (FE leg). NOTE the earlier golden was derived from PaymentResponse, a DEAD record no endpoint returns — the payment legs are now bound to the real emitter. CONFIRMED P1-68: this is MAJOR-unit BigDecimal, not integer minor units — templates/L0/fork-receiver-kit/money.ts's parseMinor() assumes minor units and disagrees with the USD/refundUsd shapes below for any non-zero-decimal currency. The request-path mirror (integer 1099 charged 100x) is the separate wave-3 P1 candidate. See docs/BACKLOG.md + the session report.

paymentUsdTrailingZero._note: boundary: PaymentBodyMapper.canonicalize() strips trailing zeros — a USD 10.90 (scale-2) amount emits as the JSON number 10.9, NOT 10.90. Pins canonicalize as load-bearing on the real wire (removing it would emit 10.90 and flip MoneyContractParityTest#paymentBody_usdTrailingZero_canonicalizesToStrippedForm RED). Only-BE golden entry; the FE leg does not consume it.

paymentKrwFullyRefunded._note: boundary: zero balance after a full refund (PAYMENT-RECON scenario)

paymentKrwLarge._note: boundary: large amount, still within Payment.amount's NUMERIC(19,8) 11-integer-digit capacity and within Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER

refundUsd._note: RefundResponse.amount is ALWAYS positive per Refund.java (refunds are their own entity, never a negative delta on Payment.amount). This is the LIVE refund wire body (PaymentController#refund).

syntheticBillingMinorNegative._note: NOT a payment-domain BE emission. Synthetic BILLING-domain-style integer minor-unit value (money.ts's own documented native shape) used only to exercise parseMinor's negative-sign handling in isolation, per templates/L0/fork-receiver-kit/money.ts's own doc comment distinguishing the BILLING (minor, integer) domain from the PAYMENT (major, decimal) domain.
